scope: Resolves all 31 remaining mobile nonliteral wire-call syntax candidates in docs/migration/parity-wire-call-sites.json (35 mobile nonliteral candidates total, minus the 4 ConditionalExpression sites already source-reviewed and accepted in parity-relay-mobile-wire-contracts v3, adding 7 names). Each of the 31 is given exactly one disposition: rpc-wrapper-traced (a genuine RPC wrapper whose concrete method(s) were traced through its actual caller(s)), transport-forwarding (a pass-through terminus in the transport stack whose argument is not itself resolvable to one method — it forwards whatever its own caller supplied), or non-rpc-subscribe-lookalike (a `.subscribe(...)` call on a receiver that is not RpcClient — a local callback/event observer). No candidate is asserted a network method without tracing its receiver. Source review only: no test, script, or product code was executed.

dispositionCounts.note: Computed per tracked call site (grouped ids like '3-6' count each of their lines); sums to totalCallSitesCovered=31.

transportEntrypointsBoundedRead.note: Bounded read (not full-file, not executed) of DirectRpcClient and StableLogicalRpcClient plus their immediate collaborators, enough to route ownership for future test ports — not a runtime capability-negotiation/pairing/reconnect execution trace.

entrypoints.role: LAN/direct-socket RpcClient implementation: constructs RpcClientConnectionState, RpcClientReconnectSchedule, RpcClientRequestTracker, RpcClientStreamRegistry, RpcSessionLivenessWatchdog, RpcClientSocketFactory, RpcClientAuthenticationRetry, RpcClientSocketCloseController; sendRequest/subscribe are pure delegation (see candidate 21-22).

Migration-aware logical client wrapping an active physical RpcClient (DirectRpcClient or a relay session); owns migrateTo/suspendActiveSession/getActivePath/getPendingPath/setRecoveryPath/setPairingRejected — the reconnect/pairing-state ownership surface; MobileConnectionPath = 'lan'|'tailscale'|'relay'.

Backoff schedule owner (RECONNECT_DELAYS ladder, RPC_RECONNECT_ATTEMPT_LIMIT=12, trickle fallback at 90s) for DirectRpcClient's own reconnect, distinct from StableLogicalRpcClient's migration/cutover logic.
Forwards a migration dial's state transitions into the logical client's published connection state; only its export signature was read.
LogicalClientConnectionPath class: the local observer candidate 30 resolves to; owns pending/recovery/pairing-rejected path state, not a wire method.

Pairing journal construction (journalId/installReqId/resumeConfirmReqId, metadata+secrets Zod schemas) consumed by pairing-relay-candidate.ts's recovery flow; only the schema/construction header was read, not the full persistence body.

settleMobileRuntimeCapabilities/negotiateMobileRuntimeCapabilities: one-way advisory capability push, tolerant of an unanswered/rejected response (isRpcDeliveryUnknown gates the tolerant path) — see bonusFindingBeyondThe31 for its method name.

transportEntrypointsBoundedRead.ownershipRouting: WP-CAP-MOBILE (client-side transport/session ownership) and WP-ENG-REMOTE (relay/pairing wire ownership) per the accepted G14 ownership in parity-relay-mobile-wire-contracts.json; this bounded read does not reassign ownership.
